title: WHY IS A GRIEVANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM NEEDED?

name: Google Shape;43;p2
text: WHY IS A GRIEVANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM NEEDED?

•  Manual handling makes complaints hard to track
•  Students may not know whom to approach
•  Complaints can be delayed or lost
•  Students need clear status visibility

•  Admins need a view of pending and resolved issues
•  Staff need complaints routed by stream
•  Solution verification needs a recorded trail
Complaint  →  Admin  →  Assigned staff  →  Solution  →  Verification  →  Resolved
Centralized review, routing and verification make each step visible.

•  Register and verify email with OTP
•  Login with Roll ID and password
•  Submit grievances
•  Upload optional supporting proof
•  Track status and view complaint history
•  Edit before admin acceptance

•  View assigned complaints
•  Start complaint resolution
•  Add remarks
•  Submit a solution
•  Upload solution proof
•  Update assigned complaint progress

•  Approve or reject student registrations
•  Review and accept or reject complaints
•  Classify streams and assign staff
•  Verify solutions and reopen unresolved complaints
•  Manage students, staff, streams and academic years
•  Monitor grievance progress
